title: انطباق المعايير وحدود ادعاء المطابقة
rule:
Applies when: When using external standards, frameworks or sector guidance.
Identify edition, amendments, document type, scope and competent applicability decision; distinguish source text from original engineering synthesis. Teaching layers do not establish authority; no full compliance, certification or clause-level claims from metadata-only review. Apply humanitarian guidance only where relevant.
rationale: دعوى امتثال من بيانات وصفية قد تنتج التزاماً تعاقدياً غير مثبت. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
